from pathlib import Path
import hashlib
ROOT=Path.cwd()
PROD=Path('/home/leonh/prediction_research_prod')
HOME=Path.home()
rels=[
'control/codex_supervisor/astra_review_wake.py',
'control/codex_supervisor/model_quality_gate.py',
'control/codex_supervisor/build_wake.py',
'control/codex_supervisor/measurement_wake.py',
'control/codex_supervisor/candidate_dispatch.py',
'control/tampermonkey_multichat/continuation_manager.py',
'control/tampermonkey_multichat/bridge_server_continuation.py',
'control/bridge_commands/command_bus_poller.py',
]
runtime_map={
'control/tampermonkey_multichat/continuation_manager.py':HOME/'.local/share/prediction-chat-bridge/continuation_manager.py',
'control/tampermonkey_multichat/bridge_server_continuation.py':HOME/'.local/share/prediction-chat-bridge/bridge_server.py',
'control/bridge_commands/command_bus_poller.py':HOME/'.local/share/prediction-command-bus/command_bus_poller.py',
}
def sha(p):
    try:return hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
    except Exception:return None
prod_m=[]
runtime_m=[]
for rel in rels:
    c=sha(ROOT/rel); p=sha(PROD/rel)
    state='MATCH' if c and p==c else ('MISSING' if p is None else 'DIFF')
    print(f'PROD {rel} {state} canonical={c} prod={p}',flush=True)
    if state!='MATCH': prod_m.append(rel)
for rel,dst in runtime_map.items():
    c=sha(ROOT/rel); r=sha(dst)
    state='MATCH' if c and r==c else ('MISSING' if r is None else 'DIFF')
    print(f'RUNTIME {dst} {state} canonical={c} runtime={r}',flush=True)
    if state!='MATCH': runtime_m.append(rel)
print('PROD_MISMATCH_COUNT='+str(len(prod_m)),flush=True)
print('RUNTIME_MISMATCH_COUNT='+str(len(runtime_m)),flush=True)
if prod_m: raise SystemExit(61)
if runtime_m: raise SystemExit(62)
print('VERSION_ALIGNMENT=PASS',flush=True)
